_about: Researched surplus-food PROSPECTS in Miami-Dade County, centered on FIU Modesto A. Maidique Campus. These are NOT enrolled FoodFlow partners and NOT verified high-waste businesses. No record here claims a business discards food. Evidence levels: measured (business-specific quantity + reporting period), documented_donation (a food-rescue organization publicly names the business as a donor), marketplace_listing (a public surplus-marketplace listing exists), none_found (identity verified, no surplus evidence found). null means unknown. See DATA_SOURCES.md.
